Name: Rest and Recover (1.6 Optimized)
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
✨ Take a Break, Farmer! ✨

Tired of eating all your crops just to get through a day of work? Rest and Recover brings a natural and immersive way to regain energy in Stardew Valley.

🚀 Key Features:
• Passive Stamina Recovery: Just take a seat on any chair or bench, and watch your energy bar climb.
• Visual Feedback: Features custom green healing particles (+) that appear over your head while resting.
• Performance First: Built with clean code to ensure zero impact on your game's FPS.
• Version 1.6+ Ready: Fully optimized for the latest update and SMAPI 4.0+.

⚙️ Technical Details:
• Recovery Rate: 0.05 stamina per tick.
• Visuals: Healing animation plays every 60 ticks (approx. 1 second).
• Compatibility: Works with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village, and all custom furniture mods.

🔧 Installation:
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your 'Stardew Valley/Mods' folder.
3. Run the game using StardewModdingAPI.exe.

---
Created by a fan, for the fans. Enjoy your rest! 💤
